scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi Krishak Sathi Sahayta Yojana
other_conditions: Applicants must hold licenses from the market committee.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000 in case of death and varying amounts (₹5,000‑₹50,000) for injuries such as amputations, de‑scalping, and other accident‑related damages.
